svg.title: Neptune, ocean-blue cloud belts and icy storms
svg.desc: Decorative blue atmospheric interpretation using detailed cloud contours adapted from Hubble's 2019 Jupiter portrait. Deep ocean blues, bright icy ribbons and fine storm filaments illustrate the theme rather than observed weather on Neptune. The static SVG has no embedded bitmap or animation. Cloud-contour source credit: NASA, ESA, A. Simon (Goddard Space Flight Center), and M.H. Wong (University of California, Berkeley). Source: https://science.nasa.gov/asset/hubble/jupiter-2019/.
